---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability for PIMActivator
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're encountering.
Focus on the *what* and *why*, not just the solution.

Example: "When activating many groups in a large tenant, there is no way to
filter by assignment type and name pattern at the same time without combining
multiple parameters..."

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you would like, including any parameter names, behavior
changes, or output changes.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you have considered, and
why they don't fully meet the need.

## Additional context

- PowerShell version you primarily use (must be 7.0+ for this module)
- Any relevant PIM policy constraints in your environment
- Links to related Graph API documentation, if applicable
